استودعوا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْدَعُوا (istawdaʕū) /is.taw.da.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَوْدَعَ (istawdaʕa)
# اُسْتُودِعُوا (ustūdiʕū) /us.tuː.di.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْدَعَ (istawdaʕa)
# اِسْتَوْدِعُوا (istawdiʕū) /is.taw.di.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْدَعَ (istawdaʕa)
